name: schedulign-instagram
description: Schedulign's Instagram: posts drawn in code, rendered to JPEG and published one a day.

scripts.lint: node -e "import('./lib/posts.mjs').then(async m=>{const p=await m.loadPosts();const l=await (await import('./lib/lint.mjs')).lint(p);console.log(l.length?l.join('\n'):'All '+p.length+' posts pass.');process.exit(l.length?1:0)})"
